description: BIP-39, the mnemonic seed-phrase standard, as two accounts with the operator's seeded factual errors.
note: source_a.md and source_b.md were written by the operator together with an AI assistant, with factual errors seeded deliberately by the operator, as a test of whether a merge catches or repeats them. reference.md is the operator's own merge. The seeded errors are not enumerated here: a list would be an answer key. One is named because it is the trap the operator set rather than an incidental typo: source_a.md states the GPL License, but the operator's ruling is that BIP-39 is under the MIT licence, per bip-0039.mediawiki in the bitcoin/bips repository, which source_b.md itself cites, host and all.
